Generate business rules documentation for the following 68 modules of the NexStep ERP system (IBM i / AS/400 RPG IV).

PROGRAM DISCOVERY (do this for every module before writing its document):
1. List all .MBR files in NXCLOUD/rpgsrc/ whose names start with the module's Prefix(es).
2. Also check NXKORR/rpgsrc/ for any overriding versions of the same files.
3. Read every discovered file. Do NOT rely on any hardcoded program list — always discover from the filesystem so new programs are picked up automatically.
4. Use the Focus description to scope which discovered programs are most relevant if the prefix is shared with another module.

For each module, write one complete markdown document directly to the output file. Do NOT print document content to stdout.

OUTPUT DELIMITER: Before writing each module's document, output this line alone:
===FILE:docs/<output-filename>===

STANDARD DOCUMENT FORMAT (apply identically to every module):

# Business Logic for [Module Name]

[Introduction paragraph: what process/module this covers, which RPG programs are involved,
and that the document focuses on conditions that BLOCK or PREVENT the operation]

## Prerequisites / Master Data Requirements
## Validation Rules
## Configuration and Authorization Rules
## Financial / Transactional Rules
## Status and Lifecycle Rules
## Special Conditions (Program-Specific)

For each rule within a category, use this exact format:

X.  **[Rule Name]**
    *   **Logic:** [One sentence explaining what the rule does]
    *   **File:** [Database file name] ([English description])
    *   **Field:** [Field name(s) only — no file name, e.g. `FOKODE` not `FOHEPF.FOKODE`]
    *   **Condition:** [Exact condition that triggers blocking, including RPG indicator names like *in41 if known]

## Subprogram Calls Affecting Logic
| Program | Trigger | Logic | Impact |
|---------|---------|-------|--------|
[one row per called subprogram — distinguish Blocking vs. Informational in Impact column]

## Reference Tables
[Status codes, type codes, and other lookup values referenced in the rules above]

MODULES TO DOCUMENT:
---

MODULE 1 | docs/invoice-business-rules.md
Prefix: FO
Focus: Block invoice creation after orders selected. NOTE: Do NOT include order-level validation (customer existence, order status, order locks, user auth) — those belong in the sales order document. Focus on FO61x programs (FO616R, FO615R, etc.).

MODULE 2 | docs/Sales-Order-business-rules.md
Prefix: FO
Focus: Block order creation, modification, picking, and fulfillment. Focus on FO1xx, FO5xx, FO614R, FO730R programs — not invoice-specific FO61x programs.

MODULE 3 | docs/customer-ar-business-rules.md
Prefix: RK
Focus: Block customer creation/modification, credit approval, payment processing, and AR posting.

MODULE 4 | docs/item-product-business-rules.md
Prefix: VV VP
Focus: Block item creation, pricing setup, and inventory control operations. For VP programs, focus on item-level price setup (VP1xx, VP4xx) — not standalone price management reports.

MODULE 5 | docs/item-product-maintenance-rules.md
Prefix: JV
Focus: Block NOBB item registration, packaging definition, supplier linking, and pricing.

MODULE 6 | docs/warehouse-inventory-business-rules.md
Prefix: LL
Focus: Block warehouse item maintenance, stock adjustments, inventory counts, warehouse type changes, and shelf location assignments.

MODULE 7 | docs/warehouse-batch-business-rules.md
Prefix: LX
Focus: Block historical inventory transfers, batch data imports, EDI status code assignments, and warehouse data synchronisation.

MODULE 8 | docs/special-pricing-business-rules.md
Prefix: FP
Focus: Block special price creation/modification, discount application, label assignment, price campaign setup, and price report generation.

MODULE 9 | docs/item-price-business-rules.md
Prefix: VP
Focus: Block item price creation/modification, batch price deletion, price book generation, and price list report parameters. Focus on standalone VP price management programs (VP5xx–VP9xx) rather than item-level setup covered in MODULE 4.

MODULE 10 | docs/item-grouping-cost-price-business-rules.md
Prefix: VG
Focus: Block item group creation/modification, group hierarchy validation, cost price maintenance, and cost price history tracking.

MODULE 11 | docs/store-retail-export-business-rules.md
Prefix: BU
Focus: Block store/POS data export, product group synchronisation, retail master data transfer to PC-kasse systems.

MODULE 12 | docs/project-unit-maintenance-business-rules.md
Prefix: RP
Focus: Block project/subproject/activity creation or modification, budget entry, project status transitions, and project reporting.

MODULE 13 | docs/unit-bonus-maintenance-business-rules.md
Prefix: VA
Focus: Block unit of measure creation/modification, bonus template setup, bonus agreement maintenance, and unit-to-item assignment.

MODULE 14 | docs/order-line-processing-business-rules.md
Prefix: FD
Focus: Block order line registration, product validation, pricing/discount application, credit limit enforcement, deposit calculation, and line status transitions.

MODULE 15 | docs/inventory-updates-history-business-rules.md
Prefix: VL
Focus: Block inventory stock updates, inbound/outbound transaction processing, stock adjustment recording, inventory history writes, and price group resolution.

MODULE 16 | docs/status-setup-codes-business-rules.md
Prefix: RA
Focus: Block creation or modification of setup codes used as foreign keys across all ERP modules. Key: duplicate code prevention, in-use deletion blocking, RA13PF allocation must total 100%, currency/salesperson/category block flags.

MODULE 17 | docs/gl-journals-business-rules.md
Prefix: RF
Focus: Block journal entry registration, batch posting, GL distribution execution, and transaction reversal. Key: batch control sum mismatch, period closed, account missing, duplicate supplier invoice#, VAT code required.

MODULE 18 | docs/gl-chart-of-accounts-business-rules.md
Prefix: RH
Focus: Block account creation/modification, GL posting to closed periods, balance matrix updates, and deletion of posted transactions. Key: required dimension flags (dept/project/cost bearer/qty), duplicate account key, VAT code must exist in RA05PF.

MODULE 19 | docs/supplier-ap-business-rules.md
Prefix: RL
Focus: Block supplier creation/modification, AP posting, payment processing, reconciliation, and supplier deletion. Key: block/passive flags, duplicate supplier invoice#, SWIFT/IBAN required for international payments.

MODULE 20 | docs/data-fixes-conversions-business-rules.md
Prefix: FX
Focus: Block data fix/conversion from running to completion. Key: source record missing, record locked, item type mismatch, missing cross-reference data, conversion table entry missing.

MODULE 21 | docs/edi-processing-inbound-business-rules.md
Prefix: LI
Focus: Block EDI message processing, matching, approval, and goods receipt. Key: LEDIPF.LISTAT already processed, supplier block/missing EDI code, order line qty/price mismatch, amount control, GTIN duplicate, concurrent processing lock.

MODULE 22 | docs/tele-payments-electronic-banking-business-rules.md
Prefix: GL
Focus: Block payment proposal creation, remittance file transfer, and bank return receipt. Key: supplier blocked, missing bank giro/IBAN, currency mismatch, proposal already transferred, GFASPF incomplete, GAVTPF not active, duplicate return file.

MODULE 23 | docs/subroutines-common-functions-business-rules.md
Prefix: RS
Focus: Return NOT-FOUND or BLOCKED result that causes the calling program to block. Key: code not in RA* register, block flag set on looked-up record, customer/supplier/project/GL account not found.

MODULE 24 | docs/system-administration-setup-business-rules.md
Prefix: AA
Focus: Block user creation/modification, company setup, library list assignment, routine registration, and system parameter maintenance.

MODULE 25 | docs/cash-register-pos-business-rules.md
Prefix: BO
Focus: Block store receipt transfer to ERP orders/invoices, daily settlement, and store register maintenance. Key: receipt already transferred, cash register inactive, customer not found, store not active.

MODULE 26 | docs/sales-statistics-reporting-business-rules.md
Prefix: SF
Focus: Block statistics recording, report generation, and period rollover. Key: period not open, supplier/item not found, statistics table locked, duplicate accumulation record.

MODULE 27 | docs/supplier-item-link-business-rules.md
Prefix: FW
Focus: Block supplier item file ingest, item creation from supplier data, price updates, and match resolution. Key: supplier not in RLEVPF, NOBB# missing, item already exists, item deleted status, price dates invalid, match register empty.

MODULE 28 | docs/data-fixes-matching-lvr-business-rules.md

---
GLOBAL RULES FOR ALL DOCUMENTS:
- Focus on what BLOCKS or PREVENTS the operation
- Use DB2 TABLE.COLUMN notation (e.g., RKUNPF.RKKUND)
- Do NOT include SQL queries — use plain English: "What is checked", "Why this is required",
  "What happens when" language with real-world examples
- Write all 68 documents in order, one after another
- Each document must start with its ===FILE:=== delimiter on its own line,
  then the # heading immediately after
